Subject: Stratatech: request for sandbox runway extension + credits (regulatory POC)

Team —

Quick ask from the Stratatech opportunity (attached). They are a highly regulated payments provider; the security/compliance review uncovered some integration blockers that require an extended sandbox window so their compliance team can run a second end-to-end audit. Key signals:
- Product team is actively running 3 integration tests (kv-cache scenarios) and hit sequence-length regressions that only show up under longer-run loads.
- They’re committed to evaluating with a live dataset in our sandbox; legal has asked for a short PO to cover post-trial support.
- ARR motion looks real: procurement indicates a target 9-figure platform spend over 24 months if POC meets SLOs.

What I need from Deal Desk / Execs: permission to grant an additional 60 days of sandbox (beyond the standard PLG 30-day cap) and a one-time complimentary credit grant of $15,000 (to cover higher token usage during extended audits). This would be a one-off for regulated POCs and tied to the success criteria in the attached spreadsheet. Without it, they pause progress and we lose calendar Q2 deployment momentum.

Risks: potential precedent for other regulated prospects; mitigation: add explicit gating — credits expire at 60 days, require the PO and signed success criteria, and limit to this specific environment.

Attachments: Stratatech_Draft_PO_2026-02.pdf, Stratatech-Pilot-Success-Criteria.xlsx

Proposed approval language to send to execs: “Approve a one-time 60-day sandbox runoff and $15k complimentary credit to Stratatech Solutions, contingent on signed PO (attached) and completion of the success criteria checklist.”

Appreciate a quick read — they want a decision by EOD Thursday 2/5 to lock an audit window.

— Dev

Appreciate the context. I can approve a constrained exception with the following hard limits: 

- Duration: +60 days sandbox extension (total sandbox = up to 90 days).
- Credits: one-time $10,000 complimentary credit (reduced from requested $15k).
- Preconditions: signed PO from Stratatech procurement and completed success criteria sheet uploaded to the deal record.
- Guardrails: credits apply only to the sandbox environment named in the PO, no conversion to production credits, audit of usage after 30 days with the right to revoke if we observe anomalous token spikes.

Rationale for reduction: we want to balance runway for the customer with limiting internal precedent. If you can get a 30/60 day split in the success criteria (deliverables by day 30 to demonstrate progress), I'll authorize the additional $5k to be released upon meeting the day 30 milestones — that would bring total to $15k but conditional.

Marissa: please draft exception language and update the deal record. Dev: send this to the customer with the PO and the conditional milestone language.
